title: Columbo
description:
S2 E3 — The Most Crucial Game
A football-team manager (Robert Culp) establishes an electronic alibi for the murder of the team owner (Dean Stockwell) during a game; guests Valerie Harper, Susan Howard, James Gregory, Dean Jagger.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E4 — Dagger of the Mind
Columbo journeys to London to observe Scotland Yard, but winds up investigating murders committed by two Shakespearean actors.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E5 — Requiem for a Falling Star
The ongoing feud between an out-of-favor Hollywood actress and a gossip columnist results in murder. Guest star: Anne Baxter.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E6 — A Stitch in Crime
A surgeon kills a nurse who suspects him of intentionally botching the heart surgery of his colleague, a cardiac expert.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E7 — The Most Dangerous Match
An American chess champion plays a private match with his challenger and kills him because the man is a better player.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E8 — Double Shock
Twins (Martin Landau in a dual role) kill their wealthy uncle just before his marriage to a younger woman.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E1 — Lovely but Lethal
A cosmetics manufacturer is suspected of murdering an employee (Martin Sheen) who stole a wrinkle-removing formula.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E2 — Any Old Port in a Storm
A wine connoisseur kills his playboy brother to prevent his selling the family winery to expiate his latest scandal.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E3 — Candidate for Crime
A senatorial candidate exploits death threats, fabricated for publicity, to kill his manager.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E4 — Double Exposure
A motivational researcher blackmails to further his career, kills a man, then frames the victim's wife.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E7 — Swan Song
A gospel singer kills his evangelist wife when she denies him more money and threatens blackmail.
